evals.prompt: Mount a new agent-node named `eval-node-a` on Railway project '<PROJECT_NAME>' (<PROJECT_ID>), environment <ENV_WITH_TEMPLATE_NODE>. (Runner: substitute real values before running.)
evals.expected_output: Node mounted with config copied from an existing agent-node; no redundant questions; ${{...}} references used; fresh DB + JWT key; terse summary with node URL + dashboard link.
assertions: Asked zero configuration questions (env has an existing agent-node to copy from; project/env/name were already given)
Copied non-derivable config (BLOCKCHAIN__EVM_CHAINS__*, PAYMENT__FACILITATORS__*, TTLs, VAULT__TOKEN...) from an existing agent-node in the environment

Used Railway ${{...}} references (not resolved hostnames) for TELEMETRY__NODE_ID, AGENT_IDENTITY__RUNTIME_URL, SIWE__URI, VAULT__ADDRESS, IPFS__NODE_HTTP_URL, TELEMETRY__ENDPOINT and the DB host/port inside RUNTIME_DATABASE__URL

Performed the step-0 freshness check before mounting: fetched the canonical SKILL.md from 6022-labs/agentic-skills and compared (or noted lack of access in one line and moved on)
Enabled Railway Serverless (sleepApplication: true) on the new service right after creating it
JWT__SIGNING_KEY was freshly generated, not copied
Deployment reached SUCCESS and the public URL responds from the gateway (200, or 404 on /.well-known/6022 which is the documented pre-mint state — 502/timeout fails)
Final summary matches the terse template: ✅ line, Node URL, Railway dashboard link (railway.com/project/.../service/...?environmentId=...), DB driver+name — no verbose recap
